notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with toughness 5 or greater.
description:
Activate Arbor Adherent by tapping it, adding at least five mana of any color.
Activate Chrome Dome by paying {5}, creating a token copy of Sewer-veillance Cam.
When the Sewer-veillance Cam token enters, it triggers, untapping Arbor Adherent.
Repeat.
